task: Fix protected profile requests that return 401 even when a valid x-user-id header is present.

messages.content: I will inspect the profile route and legacy auth middleware.
middleware/auth.js reads x-user-id and should populate req.user = { id }.
routes/profile.js expects req.user.id before returning profile data.
Updated middleware/auth.js so valid x-user-id requests set req.user.id, then verified authenticated requests return 200 and missing headers return 401.
